requirement:
A tracked read of an HC GitHub issue node records its identity and a fingerprint
of the supplied title, opening post, and status under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.evidence.node_inputs`.
Changing any of those supplied fields changes the fingerprint under the same
fingerprinting rules. The fingerprint excludes cache fetch time and TTL;
refetching otherwise unchanged issue contents does not change it.

The fingerprint describes the issue contents supplied under HC's
[redaction policy](../authoring.md#habeas-req-requirements.authoring.redaction),
including the text presented to an agent.
rationale: Add tests for `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.inputs`, then mark them with {test} references. (1) A tracked read of an HC GitHub issue node records an observation with the node identity and a fingerprint of the supplied title, opening post, and status, under `requirements.sdk.graph.evidence.node_inputs`. (2) Changing each of the title, the opening post and the status separately changes the fingerprint. (3) Refetching unchanged issue contents with a different cache fetch time or TTL leaves the fingerprint unchanged. (4) The fingerprint covers the contents supplied under the redaction policy, including the text presented to an agent. Alternatively, update the {fixme} on `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` so it names an open tracking issue. — `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.inputs` has no {test} references or :test: anchors. Its outgoing Tests edges are empty. Text searches of `src` for GitHub-issue fingerprint tests, TTL and fetch-time tests, and `github_nodes` find only the {fixme} comments in `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]`, so no test source exists. The obligations (identity plus fingerprint of title, opening post and status; per-field sensitivity; fetch time and TTL exclusion; fingerprint over redacted contents) are all untested. They are conditional and fingerprint-computing behavior, and none needs network, real elapsed time or process-wide state, so no testing exemption applies. The {fixme} on `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` names `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26`. That issue is now closed, so the acknowledgment no longer covers the gap.

Finishing a verification includes every successful tracked node read in its
`Fingerprinted`, whether ordinary code or a model tool requested it. Each observation
contains the node identity and the fingerprint of the contents actually supplied.
A failed read returns an error without inventing a successful observation.
Repeating an identical observation adds no information. Reading the same
identity with two different fingerprints preserves both observations.
